changelog: **Meeting changes are told, and a decline can counter-propose (#1982):** `PATCH /api/meetings/[id]` now tells everyone a move or a cancellation affects, through `src/lib/meetingChangeNotices.ts`. That means both sides of each relation and every guest, minus the actor, each person once per batch. The in-app events are `meeting.rescheduled`, `meeting.cancelled` and `meeting.cancelledReason` (catalogued; on the recipient's clock via `formatInTimeZone(…, intlLocaleFor(lang))`). The mails are `sendMeetingRescheduledEmail` / `sendMeetingCancelledEmail` plus the guest siblings `sendMeetingGuestRescheduledEmail` / `sendMeetingGuestCancelledEmail` (old time → new time or the reason; strings via `emailDictionary(locale, orgId)`; the guest mails are on the organizer's clock with no `/account` link; same `meeting-invite` / `meeting-guest-invite` categories as the invite). The two channels are independent, so an e-mail opt-out still gets the bell. A move also resets guests' RSVP. The `/rsvp/[token]` page offers "suggest another time" after a decline, still session-less. `POST /api/rsvp` accepts `proposedAt` + `timeZone` and files a `MeetingRequest` with the new nullable `counterOfMeetingId` (relation meetings only; a guest token declines only). The organiser sees the counter in `MeetingRequestsPanel`; accepting it calls the reschedule PATCH first, and `PATCH /api/meeting-requests/[id]` only records ACCEPTED once the meeting sits at the proposed time (409 `move_first`), so no second meeting is ever created. `MeetingsManager` gains Reschedule and Cancel (ConfirmDialog with a reason) for mentors and admins. The `meeting.rescheduled` / `meeting.cancelled` webhooks stay registered but not dispatched until `emit()` (#1693) exists (the #1697 ratchet).

en: When a meeting is moved or cancelled, everyone invited — guests included — is told, with the old and new time or the reason. Anyone who cannot make a meeting can now suggest another time, and the organiser can accept it in one click.
tr: Bir toplantı taşındığında veya iptal edildiğinde, misafirler dahil davet edilen herkese eski ve yeni saatle ya da gerekçeyle haber verilir. Toplantıya katılamayan kişi artık başka bir saat önerebilir; düzenleyen tek tıkla kabul edebilir.
de: Wird ein Meeting verschoben oder abgesagt, erfahren es alle Eingeladenen, auch Gäste, mit alter und neuer Zeit oder dem Grund. Wer nicht kann, schlägt jetzt eine andere Zeit vor, und die organisierende Person nimmt sie mit einem Klick an.
